next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993) only renumbered this rule (old GR7) and its references ('general rule 6' to 7). §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR8 a) to c) recur in §2023:14.9.22.4 GR9 outside its BACKWARD and 'or identifier-4 references a zero-length item' branches, neither reachable from 1985 syntax. 1985 b) reads 'from its leftmost character position up to, but not including, the' 'first occurrence of literal-2'; 2023 b) reads 'the first character position that is eligible to participate up to, but not including, the first occurrence encountered of literal-2', and §2023:14.9.22.4 GR3 has 'the establishment of boundaries for the BEFORE or AFTER phrase' begin 'at the leftmost character position', so the occurrence is the same one and, with BEFORE and AFTER both written (§1985:VI.6.18.3 SR4), the region is the same intersection. c) ends alike: 'is never eligible to participate in the comparison operation'.
